_note: Sonlar imperiyasi — the fixed cast. Every episode package copies these refs VERBATIM (same id, name_uz, prompt). A ref first made in an earlier episode carries "saved": true in later packages, so the brother reuses the saved image instead of generating a new face. Ids never change. Introduced = the episode where it is first generated.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

cast.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on a vast golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The same golden plain seen from ground level, and on the very far horizon a tiny glowing silhouette of a running young man made of sparkling light, half dissolved into the haze, always far away. Dramatic dusk light, sparks drifting toward the horizon.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the golden plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A chubby, energetic purple character shaped like a curvy rounded number-three shape with two bulges, big excited eyes, open mouth mid-speech, wearing a shiny wedding-host jacket and holding a golden microphone. Golden plain with festive lanterns, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. An elderly scholar character with a round kind face, small spectacles and a long white beard, wearing a deep-blue chapan robe covered in a pattern of circles, holding a coil of measuring rope. He stands beside a wooden cart wheel on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively bazaar merchant character with a curled moustache and a bright embroidered doppi cap, grinning, holding a leather coin purse that is visibly swelling and bulging with gold coins. A colourful market stall on the golden plain behind him, front view, centred.
